recognize_zh: 視野中一顆比紅血球大約兩倍、核不規則且細胞質帶深紫色粗顆粒的未成熟顆粒球（immature granulocyte，約為骨髓細胞 myelocyte 階段），加上散在的淚滴形紅血球與血小板團，呈現骨髓纖維化的周邊血液表現。
features: Single granulocytic cell with an irregular nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin and purple-blue cytoplasm containing coarse dark granules concentrated at one pole, favoring an immature granulocyte (basophil not entirely excluded)
Occasional dacrocytes and oval/elongated red cells
Normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis and occasional polychromatophilic cells
Small platelet clump and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including occasional dacrocytes and ovalocytes. A single granulocytic cell with an irregular nucleus and coarse purple cytoplasmic granules is present, favored to represent an immature granulocyte, although a basophil cannot be excluded at this resolution. Platelets are present with a small clump. Findings are consistent with a leukoerythroblastic, myelofibrotic picture, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis in context.

ddx.vs: The peripheral blood findings are identical, so a documented history of polycythemia vera is required.
Shows toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without teardrop cells or nucleated red cells.
Shows marked leukocytosis with a myelocyte peak and absolute basophilia rather than isolated immature cells with teardrops, and carries BCR::ABL1.
